connector.name: GLC Geo MCP
connector.registryDescription: Free GeoNames MCP: countries, cities, POIs, distance & nearby. Remote HTTP + agent token signup.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.glc-rag.hu over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the glc-rag account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer mcp_… API token. Agents: POST https://mcp.glc-rag.hu/api/auth/register with account_type=agent.
